narration: The model receives an input image with bounding box proposals alongside a natural language query describing a woman carrying a hat and holding a beverage.
The query sentence is parsed into a language graph, explicitly linking the woman node through carry and hold relation predicates to the target objects.
In the initialization stage, object proposals and language graph nodes are aligned into initial location heatmaps and relationship affinity matrices.
Bidirectional message propagation then executes, performing bottom-up and top-down message passing via belief selection and gating units.
Finally, the readout head pools refined multimodal representations to compute image-text matching and masked relationship reasoning predictions.
